patterns.label: Hero + Features + CTA
patterns.ctaPlacement: Hero (sticky) + Bottom
patterns.conversionNotes: Deep CTA placement. For CTA label text, verify at least 4.5:1 against the button fill; use 7:1 only when the product explicitly targets AAA normal-text contrast. Keep focus and component boundaries independently visible. Disable hero parallax under reduced motion and render its static final state.

patterns.label: Hero + Testimonials + CTA
patterns.ctaPlacement: Hero (sticky) + Post-testimonials
patterns.conversionNotes: Social proof before CTA. Use a concise set of verified testimonials with photo, name, and role. CTA after social proof. Provide previous/next and pause controls; stop rotation on focus, hover, and reduced motion; announce slide position. Previous/next buttons and keyboard controls must expose every slide without dragging.

patterns.label: Product Demo + Features
patterns.ctaPlacement: Video center + CTA right/bottom
patterns.conversionNotes: Use an interactive demo only when it explains value better than static media. Provide captions, transcript, visible play/pause controls, and a non-video fallback; do not autoplay under reduced motion. Pause media when offscreen or hidden and keep the final product state available as static content.

patterns.label: Minimal Single Column
patterns.ctaPlacement: Center, large CTA button
patterns.conversionNotes: Single CTA focus. Large typography. Lots of whitespace. No nav clutter. Mobile-first.

patterns.label: Funnel (3-Step Conversion)
patterns.ctaPlacement: Each step: mini-CTA. Final: main CTA
patterns.conversionNotes: Progressive disclosure. Show only essential info per step. Use progress indicators. Multiple CTAs.

patterns.label: Comparison Table + CTA
patterns.ctaPlacement: Table: Right column. CTA: Below table
patterns.conversionNotes: Use comparison to show unique value. Highlight your product row. Include 'free trial' in pricing row.

patterns.label: Lead Magnet + Form
patterns.ctaPlacement: Form CTA: Submit button
patterns.conversionNotes: Ask only for information necessary to deliver the lead magnet. Preview its value and show submission progress.

patterns.label: Pricing Page + CTA
patterns.ctaPlacement: Each card: CTA button. Sticky CTA in nav
patterns.conversionNotes: Highlight the plan that matches the intended audience and show actual annual savings transparently. Use FAQs to address concerns.

patterns.label: Video-First Hero
patterns.ctaPlacement: Overlay on video (center/bottom) + Bottom section
patterns.conversionNotes: Use video only when it demonstrates value better than static media. Add captions for accessibility. Compress video for performance. Provide captions and a visible pause control; use a static poster when reduced motion is requested. Pause video when offscreen or hidden; the reduced-motion poster must preserve the final message and CTA.

patterns.label: Scroll-Triggered Storytelling
patterns.ctaPlacement: End of each chapter (mini) + Final climax CTA
patterns.conversionNotes: Keep the narrative understandable without scroll-driven effects. Use progress indicator. Mobile: simplify animations. Keep DOM reading order complete; disable parallax and scroll-scrub under reduced motion. Pause scroll animation when offscreen or hidden and render each chapter in its final readable state under reduced motion.

patterns.label: AI Personalization Landing
patterns.ctaPlacement: Context-aware placement based on user segment
patterns.conversionNotes: Validate personalization with consent-aware product analytics. Requires analytics integration. Fallback for new users.

patterns.label: Waitlist/Coming Soon
patterns.ctaPlacement: Email form prominent (above fold) + Sticky form on scroll
patterns.conversionNotes: Explain early-access benefits without fabricated scarcity. Show a waitlist count only when it is current, verified, and dated. Provide a static launch deadline, pause decorative countdown motion when offscreen/hidden, and render the final readable timer state under reduced motion. Email form and referral actions remain keyboard operable.

patterns.label: Comparison Table Focus
patterns.ctaPlacement: After comparison table (highlighted row) + Bottom
patterns.conversionNotes: Show value vs competitors. Measure comparison performance with product-specific analytics. Be factual. Include pricing if favorable.

patterns.label: Pricing-Focused Landing
patterns.ctaPlacement: Each pricing card + Sticky CTA in nav + Bottom
patterns.conversionNotes: Show actual monthly and annual totals and savings transparently. Explain plan differences and address objections in the FAQ.

patterns.label: App Store Style Landing
patterns.ctaPlacement: Download buttons prominent (App Store + Play Store) throughout
patterns.conversionNotes: Show real screenshots and only current verified ratings. Provide platform-specific CTAs, buttons and keyboard controls in addition to swipe, and pause any auto-rotation. Stop auto-rotation on focus, hover, offscreen/hidden, or reduced motion and render the selected screenshot as the static final state.

patterns.label: FAQ/Documentation Landing
patterns.ctaPlacement: Search bar prominent + Contact CTA for unresolved questions
patterns.conversionNotes: Reduce support tickets. Track search analytics. Show related articles. Contact escalation path.

patterns.label: Immersive/Interactive Experience
patterns.ctaPlacement: After interaction complete + Skip option for impatient users
patterns.conversionNotes: Measure engagement for the specific audience and device mix. Performance trade-off. Provide skip option. Mobile fallback essential. Provide skip, keyboard, reduced-motion, and non-3D fallback paths. Pause animation when offscreen/hidden and preserve the completed final state when reduced motion is enabled.

patterns.label: Event/Conference Landing
patterns.ctaPlacement: Register CTA sticky + After speakers + Bottom
patterns.conversionNotes: Early bird pricing with deadline. Social proof (past attendees). Speaker credibility. Multi-ticket discounts. Expose the exact deadline as text; pause decorative countdown motion offscreen/hidden and show a static final state under reduced motion.

patterns.label: Product Review/Ratings Focused
patterns.ctaPlacement: After reviews summary + Buy button alongside reviews
patterns.conversionNotes: User-generated content builds trust. Show verified purchases. Filter by rating. Respond to negative reviews.

patterns.label: Community/Forum Landing
patterns.ctaPlacement: Join button prominent + After member showcase
patterns.conversionNotes: Preview real community value and simplify onboarding. Show member and activity counts only when current, verified, and dated; label activity as live only when backed by an active real-time source. Provide pause/update-frequency controls for moving feeds, stop work offscreen/hidden, and keep a static final state under reduced motion.

patterns.label: Before-After Transformation
patterns.ctaPlacement: After transformation reveal + Bottom
patterns.conversionNotes: Visual proof of value. Measure the outcome with product-specific analytics. Real results. Specific metrics. Guarantee offer. Provide arrow buttons and keyboard steps so dragging is not required. Arrow buttons and keyboard steps expose the same final before/after positions; reduced motion removes reveal animation.

patterns.label: Marketplace / Directory
patterns.ctaPlacement: Hero Search Bar + Navbar 'List your item'
patterns.conversionNotes: Search is the primary CTA. Reduce friction with useful suggestions. For featured-listing carousels, provide previous/next and play/pause buttons, full keyboard access, and a single-pointer alternative to swiping; stop rotation on focus, hover, offscreen/hidden, or reduced motion and render the selected listing as the static final state.

patterns.label: Newsletter / Content First
patterns.ctaPlacement: Hero inline form + Sticky header form
patterns.conversionNotes: Keep the form to the fields actually required and link to a sample issue. Show a subscriber count only when it is current, verified, and dated; otherwise use qualitative social proof.

patterns.label: Webinar Registration
patterns.ctaPlacement: Hero (Right side form) + Bottom anchor
patterns.conversionNotes: State the event time and timezone in text. Claim limited seats or live status only when current capacity or stream state is verified and timestamped. Provide pause/hide controls for the urgency ticker, stop it offscreen/hidden, keep controls keyboard operable, and render a static final state under reduced motion.

patterns.label: Enterprise Gateway
patterns.ctaPlacement: Contact Sales (Primary) + Login (Secondary)
patterns.conversionNotes: Path selection (I am a...). Mega menu navigation. Trust signals prominent. Provide pause/stop for video and rotating logos; stop on focus and reduced motion. Logo carousel controls must be keyboard operable; pause moving media offscreen/hidden and render a static final state under reduced motion.

patterns.label: Portfolio Grid
patterns.ctaPlacement: Project Card Hover + Footer Contact
patterns.conversionNotes: Visuals first. Filter by category. Fast loading essential.

patterns.label: Horizontal Scroll Journey
patterns.ctaPlacement: Floating Sticky CTA or End of Horizontal Track
patterns.conversionNotes: Immersive product discovery. High engagement. Keep navigation visible. Preserve a normal vertical navigation path and disable scroll-jacking under reduced motion. Pause effects when offscreen/hidden and render every chapter in its final vertical reading state under reduced motion.

patterns.label: Bento Grid Showcase
patterns.ctaPlacement: Floating Action Button or Bottom of Grid
patterns.conversionNotes: Scannable value props. High information density without clutter. Mobile stack. Keep cards usable without hover and suppress tilt/stagger/video motion under reduced motion. Pause card media offscreen/hidden and render cards in their final readable state under reduced motion.

patterns.label: Interactive 3D Configurator
patterns.ctaPlacement: Inside Configurator UI + Sticky Bottom Bar
patterns.conversionNotes: Let users inspect product details before purchase. Provide buttons and keyboard controls for rotate/zoom plus a 2D/specification fallback. Named rotate/zoom buttons and keyboard controls replace drag gestures; pause rendering offscreen/hidden and preserve the chosen configuration as the reduced-motion final state.

patterns.label: AI-Driven Dynamic Landing
patterns.ctaPlacement: Input Field (Hero) + 'Try it' Buttons
patterns.conversionNotes: Immediate value demonstration. 'Show, don't tell'. Low friction start. Disable typing, shimmer, and morphing effects when reduced motion is requested. Pause loaders offscreen/hidden and render generated content in its final state under reduced motion.

patterns.label: Feature-Rich Showcase
patterns.ctaPlacement: Hero (sticky) + After features + Bottom
patterns.conversionNotes: Clear feature hierarchy. One key message per card. Strong CTA repetition.

patterns.label: Hero-Centric Design
patterns.ctaPlacement: Hero dominant (center/bottom) + Sticky nav CTA
patterns.conversionNotes: One primary CTA. Let the hero dominate the initial viewport without hiding the next content cue. Use a static hero and non-pulsing CTA when reduced motion is requested; provide video controls. Pause hero media offscreen/hidden and keep the final hero message and CTA static under reduced motion.

patterns.label: Trust & Authority + Conversion
patterns.ctaPlacement: Contact Sales / Get Quote (primary) + Nav
patterns.conversionNotes: Security badges. Case studies. Transparent pricing. Low-friction form. Provide pause/stop and stop the logo carousel on focus, hover, and reduced motion. Previous/next controls provide the keyboard equivalent; pause offscreen/hidden and render a static logo set under reduced motion.

patterns.label: Real-Time / Operations Landing
patterns.ctaPlacement: Primary CTA in nav + After metrics
patterns.conversionNotes: Offer a demo or sandbox and show trust signals. Label telemetry as live only when backed by a current source, with update time and stale state. Provide pause/hide or update-frequency controls for tickers and previews, stop offscreen/hidden work, support keyboard controls, and render a static final snapshot under reduced motion.
